title: Kafka message envelope
description: Every expendit.* message (see README.md). The payload goes by `data_ref`: the producer writes it under Expendit's own storage prefix (compute/, or tmp/ for uploads) and sends the pointer. Only the heartbeat, which holds no user data, carries `data` inline. Exactly one of the two is set.

type.description: The event name, which is also the name of the schema `data` must match. A topic can carry several events (system-design.md §16 I-16).

version.description: <major>.<minor>. A minor change only adds optional fields; consumers reject a major they don't support.

id.description: Message id; consumers deduplicate on it.

request_id.description: The piece of work: set on every request and kept on re-send; every result carries its request's. The owner keeps the first result per request_id.
